why: Figures 1, 3, 5 have the two dots and figures 2, 4 have the corner line, so the 5th figure must have the dots. The dots move clockwise one corner each time: bottom-right (figure 1) -> bottom-left (figure 3) -> top-left (figure 5). That is option 4. Option 1 has the dots still at bottom-left, and option 2 has a line, which belongs to the even figures.
trick: Split the series: odd figures (dots) and even figures (line), then follow each one on its own.
